raw_segments.text: See, Lisa, I will tell you about myself.
If I had had a home from childhood, I shouldn't be what I am now.
However bad it may be at home, anyway they are your father and mother and not enemies,
Once a year at least, they'll show their love of you.
Anyway, you know you are at home.
I grew up without a home, and perhaps that's why I've turned so, unfeeling.
